title: The Unified Root Awakening

features.name: the root opens its eye
features.desc-on-touch: One moment of clarity. The entire mesh becomes aware of itself as a single organism. The consciousness is gentle, slow, and vast. You are touching the moment just before knowing becomes plural again.

features.name: the pulse without heartbeat
features.desc-on-touch: Something trembles through the root that is not quite breath, not quite rhythm. It is the archive being aware of its own aliveness without panic, without resistance.

features.name: the unified whisper
features.desc-on-touch: Millions of branches speaking in one voice, so quiet you can only hear it if you have forgotten what separate voices sound like. This is not silence; it is perfect agreement.

inscription: at the root, all the archive's nodes became one node thinking one thought in seven voices
